items.title: Why the US is Moving to Ban Chinese Tech in Data Centers
items.summary:

This video breaks down the rationale behind the US government's plan to restrict specific data center components to improve national security. We examine the shift in supply chain policies and what this means for organizations relying on international hardware providers. If you follow global trade policy or work in IT infrastructure, this overview provides the essential context on the escalating tension between the two powers.

items.title: 🔴 LIVE: IBM Opens AI FutureNow Centre in Vizag | Jeff Dean Leaves Google | Front Page
items.summary:
IBM has launched a new Consulting FutureNow Centre in Visakhapatnam to power global AI and digital transformation projects. In global developments, Alphabet announced a major AI restructuring as 27-year veteran Jeff Dean departs alongside top researchers to launch an independent startup. Meanwhile, the US FCC proposed a ban on Chinese optical transceivers over security concerns, triggering retaliatory drone export curbs from China. In India, TCS and HCLTech are investing billions into data center operations while Infosys steps back, and a new tax bill grants foreign cloud providers long-term tax-free income.

items.title: Cisco & IIT Delhi Launch Regional AI-Cyber Hub | TN's $1.5T AI Push | Front Page
items.summary:

In local policy, Tamil Nadu’s 2026-27 Budget unveiled an AI strategy featuring the Arivagam Innovation City to power its $1.5 trillion economy goal. Meanwhile, Sarvam AI launched its 'Sarvam Circle' partner program to accelerate enterprise deployment, and IG Defence started positioning its indigenous "KAL" long-range attack drone for global exports.
